messages.author: 9a0033d9324fcea3
messages.subject: Local file chooser
parts:
As I understand it, Shiny gadgets are, by definition, meant to be run locally, not deployed on a server.

Is there a gadget-focused equivalent of shiny::fileInput()? I don't want to "upload" my local file to some other local temp file. I just want a local file picker.

And/or is there a way for a gadget to access the path-forming assistance already offered by the IDE (in the Console or source editor)?
